data.title: FOMC policy rate decisions (Open Market Operations)
data.summary: The FOMC raised the federal funds target range to 5.25–5.50% effective 27 July 2023, the peak of the tightening cycle, and held it there until the 25 basis point reduction of 18 September 2024 — roughly fourteen months.
data.citation: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), Open Market Operations, policy tools archive.
